# Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction

> Real estate developer & turnkey construction company in Uttar Pradesh, developing premium residential villas, apartments, plots, commercial spaces, and custom home construction projects.

## Company Overview
- **Legal Name**: Prakhar India Real Estate & Construction (Prakhar Enterprises)
- **Website**: https://prakharind.com
- **Established**: 2014
- **Headquarters**: Plot No. 14, Industrial Area, Mirzapur City, Uttar Pradesh 231001, India
- **Coordinates**: 25.1503° N, 82.5633° E
- **Customer Support & Inquiries**: +91-9044499111 | prakharindiaofficial@gmail.com
- **Business Hours**: Monday to Saturday, 09:00 AM – 07:00 PM IST

## Core Real Estate & Construction Services
1. **Residential Real Estate Development**:
   - Gated townships, independent luxury villas, row houses, and modern multi-storey apartments.
2. **Commercial Real Estate**:
   - High-street retail shops, corporate office complexes, and business centers.
3. **Turnkey Home & Building Construction**:
   - Architectural design, 2D floor plans, 3D renderings, structural engineering (M25/M30 RCC), municipal map approvals, and fixed-price construction contracts on customer land.
4. **Interiors & Renovation**:
   - Complete home interiors, modular kitchens, wardrobes, false ceilings, and structural repairs.
5. **Township Plotting & Land Development**:
   - Verified plots with paved roads, drainage, water supply, streetlights, and gated security.

## Primary Regional Operations
- Mirzapur (Corporate HQ & Plotted Townships)
- Varanasi (Villas & Residential Projects)
- Prayagraj (Commercial & Housing Schemes)
- Lucknow (High-Rise Residential Apartments)
- Sonbhadra, Bhadohi, Jaunpur, Chandauli, Ghazipur, Azamgarh, Mau, Ballia
